# Zyvor Setura licence public keys, embedded in the binary with go:embed.
#
# One key per line:  PRODUCT BASE64URL(32-byte Ed25519 public key)
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Several lines for the
# same product are allowed (key rotation): a licence verifies if any of them
# verifies its signature.
#
# The public key is generated by the private licensing tool
# (zyvor_licence.py keygen --product setura), which writes
# public-keys/setura.pub. Paste its single line here as:
#
#   setura <contents of setura.pub>
#
# No setura key has been published yet, so this list is intentionally empty and
# every key verifies as "bad signature" until one is added. Setura itself keeps
# working without a key (source-available trial).
